name: Malaysia data.gov.my weather API (MET Malaysia forecasts, warnings)
short: MET Malaysia 7-day forecasts, weather warnings and quake notices via data.gov.my. Free, no key.
summary: data.gov.my, the Malaysian government open-data portal, serves MET Malaysia (Malaysian Meteorological Department) weather feeds over HTTP: a 7-day general forecast per location, current weather warnings with English and Malay text, and an earthquake warning feed. The docs state all weather feeds are licensed CC BY 4.0. A keyless call to the forecast and warning endpoints answered with JSON on 2026-11-06. Rate limit is 4 requests per minute. Forecast text is Bahasa Melayu only. The earthquake endpoint's first record returned was dated 2023, so it is not confirmed to hold recent events.

tasks: 7-day general forecast per district or state (daily min and max temperature, morning, afternoon, night)
weather warnings with issue time, validity and English text, updated when required
earthquake warnings (a recent-event guarantee was not confirmed)

coverage.notes: Malaysia only. Locations are district (Ds) and state (St) forecast areas, not stations. Marine forecast data is stated as unavailable.

rate_limit.notes: Stated for each API on the rate-limit page; excess requests get HTTP 429.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-06 UTC: warning issued 2026-11-07T00:40 local time (about 40 minutes before the call); forecast dated up to 2026-11-13. Docs say forecast is updated daily and warnings when required.

latency.notes: Update cadence from the docs page; one call only.

freshness.typical_age: Warning about 40 minutes old on 2026-11-06 UTC
freshness.notes: Forecasts are daily. Earthquake endpoint first record was from 2023.

licensing.summary: The docs page states: all weather feeds are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (attribution required, reuse and redistribution allowed with credit). Terms of use beyond the licence were not readable; the page links to the portal's guiding principles. Automated access is not addressed, but a published rate limit exists. AI training and resale are not addressed.

time.method: Warnings carry issued and validity timestamps; forecasts carry a date.
time.unknown: Local-time timestamps with no stated time zone in the sample.

location.method: Forecast location ids and names (district codes); warnings name regions in text.
location.unknown: Forecast areas are districts and states; no coordinates in the sample.

content.method: Official MET Malaysia forecasts and warnings.
content.unknown: Forecasts and warnings are agency products; no quality flags.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: No key needed in the calls made; docs do not mention a key.

endpoints.params: limit, contains, filter by Ds or St prefix

sources.claim: Weather feeds from MET Malaysia: 7-day forecast updated daily, warnings and earthquake warnings updated when required; all weather feeds licensed CC BY 4.0; forecast text Bahasa Melayu only
Rate limit 4 requests per minute per API; excess returns HTTP 429
Live keyless GET 2026-11-06: HTTP 200, forecast rows with location_id, date, morning/afternoon/night forecast, min_temp, max_temp (Langkawi, 2026-11-13)
Live keyless GET 2026-11-06: HTTP 200, warning issued 2026-11-07T00:40 titled Strong Winds and Rough Seas Warning, valid 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-10
Live keyless GET 2026-11-06: HTTP 200, earthquake warning first record dated 2023-10-09
